pattern: SVG node-link diagram as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "network graph") of role="img" nodes with roving focus and neighbor navigation; legend of group toggle buttons; zoom toolbar; adjacency-list data table.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription "network graph" (localized), named by the title
img with an aria-label: label, group, connection count, and up to five neighbors
list of toggle buttons (aria-pressed) for groups
table (native): node, group, connections, connected to
aria-hidden (the adjacency is in names and the table)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
Table open state and the table region id
Localized: label, group, connection count, and up to five neighbors

keyboard.action: The connected node closest to that direction (within 60 degrees); nothing happens when there is none.
Next / previous node in data order (reaches nodes without connections).
First / last node in data order.
Move the node 10px and pin it (the keyboard alternative to dragging, aui-node-pin).
Zoom in / out around the focused mark (announced politely, aui-zoom).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
One tab stop for the plot (the active mark), the zoom buttons, the legend buttons, then the Show data table button and the table region.

focus: Roving focus: one node is in the tab sequence and keeps the last visited node across re-renders, layout, and zoom. Focusing a node highlights it, its neighbors, and its edges.
notes: Groups differ by color and marker shape; each node name carries its group and neighbors; the adjacency table lists every connection.
The layout animation stops by itself (about five seconds at most) and never runs with reduced motion (WCAG 2.2.2, 2.3.3).
Dragging has single-pointer and keyboard alternatives: Shift+Arrow moves and pins, U unpins (WCAG 2.5.7).
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
Directional navigation depends on the layout; PageUp / PageDown always reach every node.
